# Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS)

CQRS architecture: separating write models (strict validation, business invariants) from read models (denormalized, optimized for queries).

## Invariants
- COMMANDS_NEVER_RETURN_DOMAIN_DATA
- READ_MODELS_OPTIMIZED_FOR_QUERY_PERFORMANCE
- EVENTUAL_CONSISTENCY_TOLERANCE
